stem.text: A transmitting mast sends out microwaves of wavelength $1.5\,\text{cm}$ and radio waves of wavelength $1.5\,\text{km}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a mountain between a transmitting mast on the left and a receiving aerial on the right, with the note NOT TO SCALE.

stem.text: A receiving aerial behind a mountain can detect the radio waves but not the microwaves.
What is the reason for this?

A.text: The radio waves are coherent but the microwaves are not.

B.text: The radio waves are diffracted around the mountain but the microwaves are not.

C.text: The radio waves are reflected by the mountain but the microwaves are not.

D.text: The radio waves travel at the speed of light but the microwaves do not.
